// Classifier fixture, vitest: the SNAPSHOT assertion class and its negative. Read as text by
// tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("snapshot", () => {
  it("renders the welcome email", () => {
    expect(renderEmail("welcome")).toMatchSnapshot();
  });

  it("renders the welcome subject", () => {
    expect(renderEmail("welcome")).toMatchObject({ subject: "Welcome" });
  });
});
